Spring Point Stop is a station of SLT Line 2602, Line 2603L, Line 2604, Line 2605, Line 2611 and Line 3803. It is located at Los Sengas Prymea. Passengers may also use this station to change to the Oasis Bay Line, Union Circular, Echo Line and Kilo Line Platforms of Spring Point Gateway.[2]

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is sister stations with Wilde Street Station, and is named after a Village Nearby that Shares Chinese Name with this station.
  • This Station is constructed as the directly travelling between this station and Sincerity Cove Station would be too far away.[2]
  • While this Station already existed at the time of Pegasus Line Construction, the arrangement of Tracks in this station resemble that of Twenty Village Station, a station that is inserted between two existing Stations on New Edward Line. This arrangement is created so that future rapid service trains may travel directly to Sincerity Cove Station without stopping at this station.
  • As this Station is constructed directly beneath an existing SLT Stop in a fashion similar to Vayler North Station, this station is constructed at a deeper level. A similar arrangement would also be seen at Luk Tsuen Station.

History[]

  • February 21 2022: This Station completed construction.[3]
  • February 23 2022: This Station began services.

Fun Facts[]

  • Unlike other Aquilo Circuit stations, the decorative materials used in the area behind the stained glass behind the tracks are different for each platform in this station. Platform 1 makes use of Spruce Leaves, whereas Platform 2 makes use of Spruce Wood, which is also present in small amounts at the concourse. Coincidentally, Platform 1 is closer to the sea and Platform 2 is further.[2]
  • During the Planning Stages of S4E9, this station was named Aquilo Cove West Station. However, due to repetition and the abundance of Spruce Trees at the vicinity of this station, it has been renamed to the current name.[3]

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is one of the three stations built to commemorate PeriodSquirrel, a former administrator of Project Nazca who left Project Nazca due to historical reasons, with the other two stations being Comrel Island Station and Perquel Island Station. The color scheme of this station, like Perquel Island Station, was also proposed by PeriodSquirrel.
  • This station is built on the same Island as Perquel Island Station in a fashion similar to how Airship Island Station and Airship Deck Station are both built on Airship Island.
  • While the Platform Screen Doors of this station were originally built with Purple and White Stained Glass[3], they have since been replaced by ordinary glass panes in order to make Stained Glass Platform Screen Doors a characteristic of Group 1 Gateways.

History[]

  • May 24 2017: This station began services.

Fun Facts[]

  • Due to limited underground space, this station is built at the northeastern side of Stack Island, and due to the late arrival of Nazca Railway compared to Peckern Transit, this station adopts the Separated Island Platform layout in a fashion similar to Elevate Island Station.[2]
  • The Waiting Passageway floor of this station is set up to merge the three staircases climbing upwards at the Platform Level into two staircases with room to add an extra floor.[3]

History[]

  • May 22 2018: This Station began services.
  • April 2 2026: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[4]

Description []

Stadium Line is a East-West Oriented Core Line in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division, and passes through Festival, Peckern, West Metropolis Archipelago, Downtown, Katadelphia, Flask, and passes under Splended River before connecting to Yowah, Cometsilk, Torrent and Clouds.

This route is represented by Light Blue Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 5.

Currently, this route is 53.22 km long, with a total of 39 stations.

History[]

Development Chapters[]

  • S1E3: Metropolis - Bonyal Estate
  • S1E4: Grass Crack - Bonyal Estate
  • S1E8: Grass Crack - Bulldoze Island
  • S1E9: Grass Crack - Peckern Forest
  • S1E10: Grass Crack - Proyga
  • S2E2: Prosand - Proyga
  • S2E4: Prosand - Intus Occident
  • S2E15: Prosand - Intus Occident (However, extension space is reserved at Virtel Heights Station)
  • S2E16: Intus Orient - Intus Occident
  • S3E10: Blackstone Village - Intus Occident
  • S3E14P1: Blackstone Village - Whitestone Village

Line Charcteristics[]

  • Named after the fact that this line passes through a large outdoors sports facility in Los Sengas (Red Stadium). This line has a station there.
  • Among the six initially planned lines of NR Los Sengas Division, this line has seen the fastest development.
  • This line runs entirely at the East-West orientation.
  • This line had held the record for being the line having the most stations in Nazca Railway twice [1]. Currently, it has the second most stations behind East Ring Line.
  • Express Services of this line:
    • Bravo Line (East): Metropolis to Intus Orient (Through Flask East, Kong Corner, Pi Lake and Virtel Heights).
    • The Shuttle (East): Metropolis to Prosand
    • Fox Line (West): Metropolis to Silver Plateau (Through Middle Island, Wativer and transfer to Xofa Line at Intus Occident).

Stadow Line is Line Number 21 of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. This line has 28 stations, and was established on November 19 2018. It runs between Black Tea Lake and Skyhorse.

Description[]

Stadow Line is one of the Auxiliary lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs along West Metropolis Archipelago and Jupiter.

This route is represented by Magenta on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 21.

This line is 39.21 km long, and has a total of 28 stations.

History[]

Development Chapters[]

Phase I:

  • S3E3: Abutment Island - Bufly Island
  • S3E4: Abutment Island - Star Island
    (Reserved tracks for this line were also built between Quad-entryway and Europa.)
  • S3E5: Abutment Island - Beam Island
  • S3E6: Abutment Island - Compass Island
  • S3E7: Abutment Island - Jessica Island
  • S3E8: Abutment Island - Europa

Phase II:

  • S3I2: Abutment Island - Io
  • S3E10: Arcgo North Island - Io

Phase III:

  • S3I5: Arcgo North Island - Goalkeep Corner
  • S3I6: Arcgo North Island - Black Tea Lake
  • S4E2: Skyhorse - Black Tea Lake

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the Auxiliary Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • This line is the sister line of Interisland Line, and mainly serves West Metropolis Archipelago.
  • All stations along this line in West Metropolis Archipelago (Except for Ponrest Station, Tenbal Island Station, Trapezium Island Station and Crane Island Station) adopts the "Oceanfloor Station" design. One main characteristic of this design is that the platform, and occasionally the concourse of the station lays at the sea outside the island in order to save space on the island.
  • This line interchanges with West Ring Line twice, once at Bufly Island Station to the north, and once at Jessica Island Station to the south.

Fun Facts[]

  • Originally, Freedom Bay Station was not a part of the plan of this line. However, in S3E7, in order to facilitate Jupiter Development, plans were added to build this station between Trapezium Island Station and Quad-entryway Station. In the end, this station was built in S3E8.
  • Phase I of this line (Between Abutment Island Station and Europa Checkpoint) took 412 days to complete. (From the beginning of construction of Abutment Island Station on November 7 2018 to the completion of Freedom Bay Station on December 24 2019).
  • This line is home to the shortest English Station Name. (Io)
  • Since the establishment of this line in S3E3, all the main episodes until S3E10 except for S3E9 involved development of this line (And for S3E9, the interlude preceding it contains the extension of this line to Io). Therefore, most players, and even the owner of Nazca Railway has referred to this line as "The Line that won't stop development". However, after S3E11, as other lines also needed to develop, this line caught a "break" for over two years before it extended once again in S3 Interlude 5 (I5) which proceeded S3E16.
  • The announcement style of this line pays tribute to West Rail Line of Mass Transit Railway in Hong Kong.

title: Standard Railway
safeHtml:
Standard Railway (Formally named Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division Standard Railway) is the main railway system of NR. It is established on March 15 2015. Currently, there are 46 Standard Railway Lines in operation, with 9 Standard Railway Lines under planning, and a standard railway line being merged with another line.

Contents

  • 3 Other Facts

Notes: Colors in the Bracket () represent the color(s) of wool used for the line. Italics represent lines that are not yet established. Strikethroughs represent lines that have been merged by other lines.

Line Characteristics[]

  • As West Ring Line, East Ring Line, Urban Line, New Edward Line, Stadium Line and Arcgo Line are all involved in the initial plans for Metropolis Terminal, they are numbered lines 1-6.
    • West Ring Line and East Ring Line are large ring lines for West and East Los Sengas respectively, with the former being the first line to be established and complete construction, and the latter being the first line to exceed 80 km, as well as the current longest line in the entire Los Sengas Nazca Railway network.
    • Urban Line and Stadium Line are north-south oriented and east-west oriented lines respectively. They respectively draw the boundaries between East and West Los Sengas, and North and South Los Sengas. However, due to geological constraints, they do not completely stick along the X/Z Axis.
    • New Edward Line and Arcgo Line respectively forms a south-oriented and north-oriented parabola along Stadium Line and travels to the four diagonals from the center. Noticeably, Arcgo Line leans to the north with a larger magnitude than New Edward Line to the south, especially at the East.
    • Therefore, as the first line that is not the Core Lines of Metropolis Terminal, Luxter Line is assigned the Number 7.
  • West Ring Line currently has two branch lines:
    • As the first branch line of West Ring Line, Expo Line is also the first line in Nazca Railway to pave tracks only after all stations along the line completed consturction.
    • Utopia Line is the Auxiliary Branch Line of West Ring Line that connects with the Nazca Railway Headquarters.
  • East Ring Line is the only line in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division that has its Main Line split in two, as well as the second line to feature such a configuration, with the first line being Islands Line of the Terracept Division.
  • Urban Line and Glacier Line are the only two lines with known plans or already have Express Services that run in a similar style with Veloducts.
    • Urban Express currently possess the longest Interstation Distance at 13.02km between Metropolis and Tat Stone Hill.
  • New Edward Line currently has:
    • The only track session that is shared by three lines in Nazca Railway (Between Seat River and Compass Island, shared with Alpha Line and Bravo Line)
    • The first line to have three termini.
  • Stadium Line currently has one branch line:
    • Xofa Line is the first planned branch line in Nazca Railway, but is not the first to be established. This line originally had plans to have a semi-circular route, with both ends of the line connecting with Stadium Line. However, subsequent planning has found out that the original routing would overlap severely with Zephyr Line, and coupled with the fact that Xofa does not have direct rail services to Teraleros, Xofa Line is therefore repurposed to be a north-south oriented line.
  • Arcgo Line is named after the fact that it serves the West Metropolis Archipelago, but ironically, it is the last line in Season 1 to enter the West Metropolis Archipelago. Moreover, this line also faced multiple difficulties and changes in its planning stages, and more details of these can be seen at the page of that line.
    • Skyward Line serves as the branch line of Arcgo Line, and has become a final substitute service for Mayler Airport as Arcgo Line did not serve that airport.
  • Luxter Line currently has two branch lines, with plans for a third one:
    • Sava Line is the first branch line of Luxter Line and Nazca Railway's first Branch Line to copmlete construction. As it references Ma On Shan Line of the MTR, it was the first line in Nazca Railway to be built to Sub-Standard Railway Standards. However, the entire line has since been expanded to Standard Railway Standards. Currently, this line is still the longest branch line in Nazca Railway at 16.17km long, and still possess the shortest Interstation Distance at 560m between Southend and Savanna Central.
    • Swift Line is the second branch line of Luxter Line;
    • Wingthorn Line is the third branch line of Luxter Line under planning. Once complete, Luxter Line will be the first Nazca Railway line with three independent Branch Lines.
  • Sava Line and Flask Line also takes references to Tuen Ma Line (then Ma On Shan Line and West Rail Line respectively):
    • Sava Line pays tribute to Ma On Shan Line, whereas the section between Flask East and Internal Sea East for Flask Line takes references to the section along the Pat Heung Depot of West Rail Line.
    • Rumors of the two lines merging together also exists, but ultimately, it didn't happen. Instead, the two lines interchange at Peacean Island and Gunshot Island.
  • Kinight Line already has plans to have a second Terminus at Sheung Che Nung besides of the first one at Edward Island. However, this is not realized until S3E13P2.
  • Daring Line is the first Nazca Railway line to adopt right-hand traffic, and its 0 mD Sign is located at the large triangluar interchange at Peckern between Peckern Forest, Wativer and Congorge stations. Therefore, the Up and Down Platform Numbers were initially reversed between Wativer and Congorge. However, subsequent Station Numbering has ignored this fact, and has instead opted with Centopia being the "Zero Station".
  • Daring Line, Zephyr Line, Sparkling Line all serve the Nazca Railway Headquarters, and as a result, the latter two lines follow up from the number of Daring Line, and are assigned the numbers 10-12.
    • As a result, the Line Numbers of Zephyr Line, Sparkling Line, Origin Line, Minecraft Line and Ingress Line are rearranged, with the most apparent example being the number of Ingress Line being rearranged from 11 at the planning stages during S1E19 to the current Number 15.
    • Zephyr Line and Sparkling Line originally planned to be established when the Nazca Railway Headquarters are built, but due to the premature development of Xofa, these two lines are established in early on in S3E6.
  • Origin Line, in its initial incarnation, only passed through Katadelphia and did not have stations in that district. However, eventually, Kamelen and Samenta are inserted in that district, and as a result, this line became the first line to have stations inserted in the middle more than once.
  • Minecraft Line initially had plans to connect between Miner North and Tat Stone Hill. However, due to Jupiter development, this line goes to Europa instead, and this has also indirectly caused Oasis Bay Line to serve parts of the original planned line.
  • During its planning stages, Ingress Line was named Snoast Line, and its original route is also slightly different from its current Route. Eventually, this line, Glacier Line and Coopol Line are respectively planned to traverse through East, West and Central Ingress Continent from the South to the North.
  • Oasis Bay Line, Abyss Line, Interisland Line and Stadow Line, alongside Luxter Line and Flask Line, are planned by Nazca Railway to form a ring network around Metropolis Terminal during later stages of Season 2. This guarantees that passengers commuting between various Districts and Interchanging do not have to rely too heavily on lines entering Downtown.
  • Oasis Bay Line once had two separate sections, with the west section being defined as West Oasis Bay Line. This also became the only example of a Temporary Line in Nazca Railway.
  • Interisland Line and Stadow Line are sister lines that mainly serve the West Metropolis Archipelago Vicinity, with Interisland Line being the first line that only sets station within the West Metropolis Archipelago.
    • Gondola Line is an Independent Branch Line that is derived from the original Interisland Line Branch, and connects between Interisland Line and Stadow Line. Thus, it is defined as a "Bypass".
    • Due to changes in plans and geological constraints, Gondola Line became the first line to adopt an Oceanfloor Station Design instead of the originally planned Stadow Line.
  • Cometsilk Line, Aquilo Circuit, Odyssey Circular and Union Circular are several circular lines planned by Nazca Railway that succeeds West Ring Line, East Ring Line. Unlike West Ring Line and East Ring Line, both of which covers large areas of Los Sengas, these four circular lines have aims to either serve specific districts or act as "Pioneer Lines" into new areas.
    • As the third line to form a complete ring, Cometsilk Line mainly serves Cometsilk and north Prymea. While Harvest River is a rare instance of a Ring Line having a "Terminus", that station can also be seen as a part of the Cometsilk Line ring as passengers can choose to remain in teh train and travel to other stations along the original direction.
  • Glinstrouß Line, Prospektious Line and Everchord Line are all District Lines serving Peckern North:
    • Glinstrouß Line took two and a half years between the planning and constructing stages, and in the meantime, Tin Shek New Town has also undergone reconstruction.
    • Glinstrouß Line and Everchord Line has plans to cross-interchange in Pekcern North multiple times, with known instances including the already existing Tin Kam and Ramseqeu, as well as the under planning Poon Tong.
    • Prospektious Line is a long-term route that will extend to the northwest from Peckern North.
  • Asylum Line, Snowty Line and Lingshan Line, alongside Ingress Line, Glacier Line and Coopol Line, are all major routes within the Ingress Continent.
    • Asylum Line mainly runs between the northwest and the southeast of Central Ingress Continent to facilitate passenger flow, whereas Snowty Line and Lingshan Line, alongside Rover Line are the main east-west oriented lines within the Ingress Continent.
    • The latter three (Ingress Line, Glacier Line and Coopol Line), form a north-south grid network alongside Arcgo Line.
  • Pegasus Line and Phoenix Line are sister lines within the "Strategic Railway Plan" of Nazca Railway. These two lines are built to further secure the grid tightness and interchange convenience among the Nazca Railway network. Interestingly, besides of the Butterfly-like routing within Downtown, the general direction of development of these two lines are similar to that of New Edward Line and Arcgo Line.
    • Since the establishment of Pegasus Line and Phoenix Line in S3E16 and S3E18 respectively, these two lines have seen more frequent development than other lines, and has simultaneously broke the record of the Second Longest Line which was held by Stadium Line, and are currently the second and third longest lines respectively behind East Ring Line.
  • Akashi Line, Daybreaker Line and Vision Line are District Lines in TriPaw and the Twenty-Second Continent.
    • Akashi Line mainly deals with serving passengers bewteen TriPaw and the Twenty-Second Continent, as well as increasing railway coverage in the middle of the Twenty-Second Continent. Its original circuitous route within TriPaw has also since been broken into Daybreaker Line;
    • Daybreaker Line provides eastbound railway connections from TriPaw to Oasis and Prymea;
    • Vision Line is the branch line for the Twenty-Second Continent section Akashi Line, and is built to further cover the south of the Twenty-Second Continent. Its overall route and design is similar to that of the initial plans of Xofa Line.
  • Wanderer Line was initially planned as an auxiliary route at the south of Jupiter, but is now planned as another east-west oriented line that runs to the south of Oasis Bay Line;
    • The section between Cranerock Mount and Markost shares structure with The Great Liberty Bridge, and with an interstation distance of 10.18km,, it has overtaken the Section between Flask Line and Internal Sea East of Flask Line as the longest non-Express Line Interstation Distance in Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division).
  • Starshore Line and Union Circular are lines planned around Spring Point, and has long-term plans to serve Union and Duotwirl.

Other Facts[]

  • Utopia Line is the only line that serves Centopia and does not use it as its "Zero Station".
  • East Ring Line has the two widest sets of Island Platforms at Circle Pit Station (53m) and Wooden Abyss Station (55m).
  • East Ring Line and Egress Line has a "D-shaped" route between Rapid Rivulet and Parallel Bay within the Egress Continent. Katadelphia Railway also adopted a similar design.
  • Parts of Stadium Line shares tracks with Bravo Line (Formerly Echo Line), between Raytree and Prosand.
  • Xofa Line is currently the only railway line travelling out of Teraleros, and was also formerly the only railway line travelling out of Xofa.
  • Plans for Ingress Diamond Station serving Luxter Line and Ingress Line already existed in S1E19 from inside the Station Control Room of Ingress South Station, but that station did not come into fruition until S2E12 when Ingress Line is established.
  • Sava Line was formerly the longest Branch Line in Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division) at 10.395km, but was overtaken by another Branch Line of Luxter Line, Swift Line in S3E13P2 at 10.66km. However, since S3E14P1, Sava Line has reclaimed the record.
  • Sava Line has a shorter average interstation distance than other lines between Savanna Central Station and North Mountain Station, but the interstation distance has returned normal between North Mountain Station and Peacean Island Station.
  • Flask Line used to have the longest Standard Railway Interstation Distance between Internal Sea East Station and Flask East Checkpoint, but is ultimately replaced by Urban Express. The longest Interstation Distance for non-express Lines is also replaced by Wanderer Line.
  • Flask Line has three consecutive stations in Ingress, Internal Sea and Flask. Coincidentally, the three consecutive stations not only exist in different Districts, but also contains the word "East", with East Margin Station corresponding to Ingress, Internal Sea East Station corresponding to Internal Sea, and Flask East Checkpoint corresponding to Flask.
  • Parts of Minecraft Line shares tracks with Charlie Line.
  • Ingress Line already appeared in the form of reserved platforms in S1E19, but did not appear until S2E12.
  • Glacier Line has a higher-pitched announcement voice than other lines, reflecting the same scenario with the South Island Line in the MTR during its early stages of operation.
  • Glacier Line is the second line to adopt a Bridge Core Design at Elevated Sections after Oasis Bay Line.
  • Glacier Line adopts an Oceanfloor Tube Tunnel Design between Causeway Bay Station and Qoser Coast Station, and is the fourth Line to adopt this Tunnel Design after Gondola Line, Stadow Line and Oasis Bay Line.
  • All Stations along Glacier Line uses Liquid Platform Screen Doors and Glass Floors.
  • Oasis Bay Line has a semi-circular shape between Cansand Bay Station and Southern Heights Station.
  • Parts of the Elevated Section of Oasis Bay Line also adopts the Bridge Core Design, and sections to the south of Bottom Woods Station also adopts an Oceanfloor Tube Tunnel Design.
  • While Daybreaker Line passes through West Ring Line, Urban Line and Minecraft Line, it does not interchange with any of these lines.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the last station to undergo expansion in 2018.
  • One of the players in this server (Kata Ho) had once mispronounced the Chinese Name of this station as "Five-Star Corner Island Station".[3]

History[]

  • September 23 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • December 18 2018: Stadow Line extends from Bufly Island Station to this station.
  • June 8 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

  • This Station is named after the street of the same name above this station.
  • The ramdomly placed Glowstone alludes to the name of this station (Stardust).[2]
  • The Main Building Materials used for the two platforms are reversed. While Platform 1 predominantly uses Black Wool, Platform 2 predominantly uses Orange Concrete.

History[]

  • September 26 2022: This station completed construction.[3]
  • September 27 2022: This station began services.

Description []

Starshore Line is one of the Auxiliary lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs southwards from Cometsilk towards Prymea, with possibilities to extend further south.

This route is represented by Dark Purple on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 45.

Districts Served[]

  • Cometsilk
  • Prymea

History[]

Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Start from Nail Bight Checkpoint and travel south towards Spring Point Gateway, where it interchanges with Oasis Bay Line, Daybreaker Line and Kilo Line. Future projections will see it continue south. Completed
(Chapter: S4E10)

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the Auxiliary Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • Express Services of this line:
    • Kilo Line (South): Nail Bight - Spring Point
  • The name of Starshore Line comes from Starshore, the District in which Phase I Development of this line takes place. However, by the time this line is named, Starshore has already merged into Prymea.
  • Phase I Development of this line (Between Nail Bight and Spring Point) has many symmetries and correspondances:
    • Both ends of this line (Nail Bight and Spring Point) are six-line interchange stations.[1][2]
    • Both Rougewood and Firstflare are stations that are related to the concept of Heat, and both stations feature interchanges with the Sava Light Transit.
    • Both Welliant Plateau and Angelica Moss makes use of the nature as the theme of the station. While Welliant Plateau uses the mountains directly to its west, Angelica Moss makes use of plants. Moreover, both stations feature interchanges with another Heavy Rail Line, with Welliant Plateau changing with Cometsilk Line and Angelica Moss changing with Evillow Line.[3]
    • In the three comparisons above, the three former stations are all situated to the north of the canal situated at central Prymea, whereas the three latter stations are all situated to its south, forming a symmetry.
  • Moreover, the Phase I development of this line differs with the usual Nazca Railway development with regards that, while Kilo Line is used as the express service for this line, as Nazca Railway wanted to make Spring Point Gateway the 500th Station to be built, Kilo Line's development, or rather the express services of this line, precedes the development of this line.

Station of Friendship is a station on Origin Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Flask. Passengers may also use this station to change to Central-Yowah Railway Yowah Line (Riverwest Station) and StarTop Railway Cadence Line (Warmfox Shoal Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • The station number of Origin Line for this station was 13-04. However, it has later been changed to 13-05 with the completion of Samenta Station.
  • To show the importance of Friendship, this station is named "Station of Friendship" instead of "Friendship Station". However, due to limitations in the Station Infobox, the name "Friendship Station" is shown.
  • The name of the stations of the lines that have a connection to this station is not the same as this station.

History[]

  • February 21 2020: This station began services.
  • July 14 2022: Due to the completion of Samenta Station, the Origin Line station number has changed from 13-04 to 13-05.[3]

Types[]

According to the building format of NR, stations can be categorized into 8 types.

Type I[]

Type I stations, also known as Elevated Stations, are stations in which the platforms are built at least one floor above ground level. Most Type I Stations have elevated tracks at either direction of the platform.

Style[]

Most Elevated Stations make use of island platforms, where the concourses are located directly below the platforms. In most cases, the Concourse is located on Ground Level, but there are also some examples in which the concourse is also elevated, such as Eastbiome and Xofa Bayside.

However, some concourses, due to Geological constraints, would adopt unconventional designs when the station structure passes over other structures like rivers and roads, such as:

  • Concourses being split into two or more structures (eg. Justin)
  • Shrunk Concourses that are shorter than the Platform (eg. Bulbacon)
  • Platforms and Concourses being built in separate structures (eg. Crossriver)

Type II[]

Type II stations, also known as Ground Stations, are stations that are built on the ground.

Style[]

Platforms and tracks of such stations are built on the ground, and side platforms are usually used. The concourses of these stations can be in various locations, either above, on the side of, or below platforms, with exits connecting the concourse and the ground outside of the station. However, there are also stations, such as Heart River, that put the exit directly next to the platforms.

Type III[]

Type III stations are also known as Underground Stations, and they are commonly found in urban and mountainous areas.

Style[]

Both the platforms and the concourses of such stations are located underground, with both island platforms and side platforms being considered when designing. Usually, for such stations, concourses are located above the platforms, featuring multiple exits to the surface. Some exits can be extended by tunnels, and as a result, exits may not need to be located next to the main structure.

Type IV[]

Type IV stations are also known as Island Stations. It is named after the fact that the first time Nazca Railway adopts such a design is at the West Metropolis Archipelago. These stations are found in island areas if Type VII station is not considered, but with a minority of exceptions. This station type is also seen in areas with small underground space.

Style[]

This type of stations commonly uses split stacked platforms, with narrower platform widths. Such designs enable stations to be built with little underground space. Such an arrangement is common in island areas and areas with intensive urban development, such as Red Millet Station.

The councourse is mostly constructed on top of the upper platform, with exits that adopt a similar design of Type III Stations. Stations may even be connected to neighbouring light rails with flexibility depending on the negotiation between Nazca Railway and the local developers. As a result, "Octopus Exits", which refer to exits being located far from the concourse, is common in this type of stations.

As some islands have decentralized structures, some stations will also feature a passenger shuttle for exits, with Earn Island being a prominent example.

Type V[]

Type V stations, also known as Pseudoground Stations, are derived from the Typ III Underground Stations.

Style[]

Despite being called Pseudoground Stations, the structure of such stations resembles Underground Stations. However, unlike Underground Stations, the concourses of Pseudoground Stations are on ground level, while the platforms are designed in a fashion similar to Ground Stations. The most obvious difference is that Pseudoground Stations use Platform Gates while Underground Stations use Platform Screen Doors.

List of Stations[]

  • Standard Railway:
    • Main Lines:
      • East Ring Line: Origin Pond, Pier Cliff

Type VI[]

Type VI stations are also known as Floating Stations.

Style[]

Floating Stations are constructed with no "supporting" columns. It is also worth mentioning that, among the four Floating Stations, only Johnson Views and Royal Mount are literally "floating" stations, while East Margin and Galileo Heights have pillar that resemble supporting points due to the connection between the concourses, which are not floating.

List of Stations[]

  • Standard Railway:
    • East Ring Line: Johnson Views
    • Flask Line: East Margin
    • Glacier Line: Royal Mount
    • Pegasus Line: Galileo Heights

Type VII[]

Type VII stations are also known as Oceanfloor Stations[1].

Style[]

The platforms are built on the oceanfloor, with glass covering the platform structure in a fashion similar to an aquarium. Depending on the size of the island and the surrounding terrain, the concourses can be built either are sea or under land.

As these stations may not need to built in the island itself, this design ensures that smaller islands and areas with limited usable underground space could be covered by NR. Sometimes, two islands can share one station. Currently, Le Monde and Canusoar Cape are the only examples of Type VII Stations that are not built next to an island.

List of Stations[]

  • Standard Railway:
    • Main Lines:
      • New Edward Line: Le Monde
      • Flask Line: Peacean Island
      • Daring Line: Le Monde[2]
      • Stadow Line: War-arc to Yashi Island, San-loop, Peanut Island to Rollhill Island, Sunrise Island to Arcgo North Island
      • Pegasus Line: Canusoar Cape
      • Akashi Line: Le Monde
    • Branch Lines:
      • Sava Line: Peacean Island
      • Gondola Line: All Stations (Except for Earn Island)
  • Veloducts:
    • Bravo Line: Le Monde

Type VIII[]

Type VIII stations are also known as Cavern Stations.

Style[]

Platforms and concourses in such stations share the same underground space in a fashion similar to Oasis Bay Line underground stations built before Season 4. However, the structure will extend about four meters from the two ends of the platforms resprectively. Also, a water pool 3 to 8 meters deep is created in each station in a fashion similar to a cave, hence the name of this station type.

The sides of the platforms have supporting columns, with glass floors set up in a Style and density is similar to Treeless Hill, and the glass floor on the concourses can see through the platform level(s).

List of Stations[]

  • Standard Railway:
    • Arcgo Line: Havenore
    • Glinstrouß Line: Kivotos
    • Prospektious Line: All Stations
    • Pegasus Line: Candor Plains, Sincerity Cove
    • Phoenix Line: Sincerity Cove, Candor Plains
    • Vision Line: Long Bay to Lorepine

Mixed Type Stations[]

This is a technical classification. As some stations have to accommodate the lines' height or adding lines to the stations, they have to mix the 8 types above. The common mixes are Type I+III (Elevated + Underground), Type I+II (Elevated + Ground), Type II+III/V (Ground + Underground/Pseudoground), and even triple mixes.

Steep Pond Station is a station on Luxter Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Ingress. Passengers may also use this station to change to Mushroom Transit Samui Line (Steep Pond Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is the first station to be built with signs that show the Station Number of the station upon construction. The System has since been adopted across Nazca Railway.

History[]

  • October 10 2019: This Station began construction.[3]
  • January 6 2021: This station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[4]
  • March 28 2022: Exit E is added to this station to connect to the Mushroom Transit Station of the Same Name.[5]

Stem Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is also a constituent of the Note Group.

Contents

  • 1 Location
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 SLT
    • 2.2 Peckern Transit
    • 2.3 Routes
  • 3 Citations and References

Location[]

Stem Island is located between Heeled Island and Caver Island. West Ring Line passes over the west of this island without stopping, and it is also the westernmost island among the Note Group. Tower Isle to the northwest of this island is a subsidiary isle of this island.

The earliest pictures of West Metropolis Archipelago shows that the island to the east of the current Stem Island is the Note Group, and the island to the east of the Note Group is the original Stem Island. However, as time passes, players got accustomed to referring to the three islands as Note Group, whereas the three aforementioned islands from the west to the east are colloquially referred to as Stem Island, North Stem Island and South Stem Island to this day.

Transport[]

SLT[]

  • Line 501 North Stem Bay Stop
  • Line 501, Line 502 Note West Stop

Peckern Transit[]

  • Northland Line Stem Island Station

Routes[]

Before this island was regenerated, Route 6 had an exit on this island. This enabled road traffic to Tower Isle, Caver Island and Heeled Island. After the island regeneration, this island was no longer accessible by road, but the connecting road to nearby Caver Island was reestablished when redevelopment works for this island began on February 12 2025.

Stone Shoal Station is a station on Stadium Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Peckern. History[]

  • July 9 2015: This station began services.
  • June 1 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[2]
  • December 21 2016: Exit D is added to this station to change to Peckern Transit Stone Shoal Station and Cities Transit Stone Shoal Station.[3]
  • January 31 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • December 23 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]

Fun Facts[]

  • The name and design of this station corresponds to the Strange Quark, one of the six types of Quarks. To correspond to the element of "Strange", Green is used for this station, and a list of "Strange" occurrances regarding this station occurred as follows:
    • Trains slow down when entering this station from Charm River Station for no good reason.[3]
    • A small section of Oceanfloor Tunnels appeared when trains enter this station from Bottom Woods Station.
    • Trains suddenly adopt the right-hand traffic rule at this station for absolutely no reason.[4]
    • Among the six Quark-themed stations on Oasis Bay Line, this station is the only station that uses side platforms.
    • The Platform Screen Door Sounds when opening the door and closing the door are reversed.
    • The Station Report for this station is released earlier than that of Charm River Station.
    • The Welcome to Strange Channel Station sign is NOT placed on the sign with Thank you for travelling on NR. Instead, it is placed near the bridge that is connected to the exits.
    • The Station Sign of this station is wrapped.
    • For Platform 1, the "Previous Station, Current Station, Next Station Sign" had capitalized letters at odd numbered positions when highlighting the station name. The same applies for even numbered positions at the same sign of Platform 2.
    • A look at the Announcement Pack for Nazca Railway trains will see trains entering from Bottom Woods having the English and Chinese Announcements swap orders, whereas trains entering from Charm River has the announcements played in reverse. Moreover, the numbers of announcements are also reversed!
  • With a floor height of just 2.5m beneath the bridges connecting to the exits, this station has the lowest ceiling floor height in Nazca Railway.

MiScElLaNeOuS[]

The following strange occurrances also happened during the editing of the wiki page of this station:

  • When the editor of this wiki created this page, it was named Strange River Station, and the editor did not notice it. That's Strange!
  • For the Station Layout of this station, Platforms 2 and 1 are inverted on purpose, and the floor layout is also inverted, and the sides of the NR Dex in this station are also inverted on purpose. That's also very strange.
  • For the Station Number column of this station, while all other stations have a format that looks like this: [17-07] (Thanks to some old folk who thinks that it is a good idea to use this new format in Centopia and forced the founder of this wiki to do the same for the rest of the stations), this page still retains the old format. How strange!
  • If you look further down, the Next Station and Previous Station are reversed for no reason as well.
  • While the Odd Numbered Letters are capitalized for the first words of the passage, Even Numbered Letters are capitalized at the Station Infobox. Moreover, did you notice that the wiki editor is being unusually rude at the Station Infobox? How very unprofessional of him.
